meta.description: Grows an open cap at every point, e.g. from points_on_path at the tip of the stipe: guide rays that leave the stipe and follow the drawn profile out to the margin. Gives the paths it gets with the rays added. Fill the gaps between the rays with fill_gaps, pose them with margin_waves, cap_lopsided, margin_curl and cap_open, then fill them with strands.

plant.description: The stipes, the rays are added to them

points.description: Where the caps sit, one cap at every point: on the path of the point at its alpha, around the direction of the path there

radius.description: Radius of the open cap, the profile spans from the axis to this radius

profile.description: The outline of the open cap seen from the side, from the top over the stipe to the margin. Width and height keep their proportions, the half width of the box is the radius.

thickness.description: Thickness of the flesh. Connect a curve to thin it from the centre (alpha 0) to the margin (alpha 1).

rays.description: Rays that leave the stipe top, evenly around it. fill_gaps adds more where they drift apart towards the margin.
